Control flow for Lit

HTML that thinks.

Write Angular-inspired control flow in Lit templates. Build real Web Components with familiar, declarative markup.

@if conditions @for loops @switch branches
Explore interactive demos → Read the getting started guide
A SMALL EXAMPLE
return nghtml`
  @if (${this.items.length > 0}) {
    @for (item of ${this.items}; track item.id) {
      <p>{{ item.label }}</p>
    } @empty {
      <p>Nothing here yet.</p>
    }
  }
`;

NGHTML analyzes the template and renders it with Lit.
